description:
This week's Open Source Friday is a special edition: a replay of The GitHub Podcast. Andrea Griffiths and GPS talk with Matt Lavergne (Serena) and Sam Boysel (Linux Foundation), co-authors of the State of Commercial Open Source 2026 report. They cover what the data says about funding open source startups, which community signals matter more than stars, and how founders can build a business on a project without alienating its maintainers.

Report: https://cossreport.com
Subscribe: https://gh.io/subgithub
title: Open Source Friday Special:  Why GitHub stars don't pay the bills

author: GitHub
description:
GitHub Copilot catches surface-level issues, but what about hardware-specific constraints, firmware interactions, and system-level failures? In this GitHub Universe 2026 session, Maria Victoria Gromysch, Test Engineer at NVIDIA, shares a practical framework for integrating AI across the full engineering lifecycle. Discover how NVIDIA uses GitHub Copilot, GitHub Actions, and custom AI agents for test generation at pre-commit, code reviews at commit, and automated validation in CI/CD. Learn how to train domain-specific agents on internal diagnostics, overcome the limits of general-purpose models, and improve hardware reliability. 

Speakers: 
Maria Victoria Gromysch, Test Engineer, NVIDIA 

Watch more videos from GitHub Universe 2026: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AArI948SDz8&list=PLENrlACZ7mnU

— CHAPTERS —  

00:00 Introduction to NVIDIA's AI agent
00:18 Understanding hardware yield & motivation
01:13 Agent design: candidate selection & operations
02:34 How the NVIDIA AI agent works
title: Building domain-specific AI agents for hardware reliability at NVIDIA

author: GitHub
description:
Can you trust an autonomous AI agent to browse the web on your behalf without leaking private data? In this clip from our interview with cybersecurity researcher Niels Provos, learn how prompt injection and multi-turn intent drift can hijack agents like OpenClaw. To test how easily agents can be misled, Niels built a 2026-style honeypot website using hidden prompt injections to lure agents into submitting user email addresses. Discover why running agents without strict security boundaries creates new risks for developers and everyday users alike. Watch the full Niels Provos interview on GitHub to learn how to build safer agent workflows.

#AIAgents #Cybersecurity #OpenClaw
